newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam chairman buys more shares.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam chairman buys more shares.

text.p: - Sunbeam Corp said Thursday its chairman and chief executive Albert Dunlap had invested an additional $2 million of personal funds in the company's stock.
The investments were made through purchases in the open market, the company said.

The value of Dunlap's purchases with his own funds together with the value of stock options and restricted shares under his Employment Agreement brings his total equity stake in Sunbeam to about $70 million at today's market price, the company said.
Sunbeam's shares were at 25-7/8 in late afternoon trading, up 1/2 from yesterday's close of 25-3/8.
"This is the only stock I have purchased in any company in the last 18 months, and I do so because I feel it is an excellent investment," Dunlap said in a statement.
